lessons.title: Amina's Saturday
lessons.summary: A short text about a weekend routine.

passage.title: Amina's Saturday
paragraphs: Amina lives in Eldoret. On Saturday morning she goes to the market with her mother. They buy tomatoes, onions and fish. Amina carries the bag because her mother's hands are full.
At noon they walk home and cook lunch together. In the afternoon Amina studies English for two hours. In the evening she calls her cousin, who lives in Nairobi.

questions.prompt: Where does Amina go on Saturday morning?
questions.why: The text says she goes to the market with her mother.

questions.prompt: What does Amina do in the afternoon?
questions.why: In the afternoon Amina studies English for two hours.

questions.prompt: Why does Amina carry the bag?
questions.why: She carries the bag because her mother's hands are full.

passage.title: A new school
paragraphs: Brian starts at a new school on Monday. He is nervous because he does not know anyone. The teacher, Mrs Otieno, introduces him to the class. A girl called Faith shows him where to sit.
At break time, Faith and her friends invite Brian to play football. By the end of the day, Brian is happy. He tells his father, "I think I will like this school."

questions.why: He is nervous because he does not know anyone.

questions.prompt: Who introduces Brian to the class?
questions.why: The teacher, Mrs Otieno, introduces him.

questions.prompt: What do Faith and her friends invite Brian to do at break time?
questions.why: They invite him to play football.

questions.prompt: How does Brian feel at the end of the day?
questions.why: By the end of the day, Brian is happy.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to "nervous"?
questions.why: Nervous means worried or a little afraid.

passage.title: The town library
paragraphs: The town library opens at eight o'clock and closes at five o'clock from Monday to Friday. On Saturday it closes at one o'clock. It is closed on Sunday.
Members can borrow three books at a time for two weeks. If a book is late, the member pays a small fine. Students can also use the quiet room to study for free.

questions.prompt: What time does the library close on Saturday?
questions.why: On Saturday it closes at one o'clock.

questions.prompt: How many books can a member borrow at a time?
questions.why: Members can borrow three books at a time.

questions.prompt: What happens if a book is late?
options: The member pays a small fine
questions.why: If a book is late, the member pays a small fine.

questions.prompt: What can students do in the quiet room?
questions.why: Students can use the quiet room to study for free.
